objective: Cancel an initial/midway physical Dispatch approach without disabling its route owner; finish safe handling/return and permit same-hull reuse.
owner: operations_developer; one bounded execution owner; no nested worker/goal/retry scheduler
source_observation: cancel sets Cancelling before cancel_after_route; next_boundary/advance_to own only active route states. Existing _finish_route already consumes cancel_after_route on arrival, but overwriting approach state makes that arrival unreachable.
acceptance: Independently reproduce the preserved immediate no-stock approach cancellation before source edit; after fixing it the same hull reaches legal safe parking with original crew and actual fuel burn, no phantom HQ cargo and no live manifest/home-lane claim.

Cancel midway through a real approach with20 actual reserved fixture rounds and real fleet/passenger commitments. Release only those predeparture claims; retain captured route/deadline and actual hull/crew/cargo custody through safe return.
Repeated/late cancel and mode/route/field-gun edits cannot reopen withdrawal or affect a later reused hull manifest.
The returned hull can physically load/depart/unload20 actual rounds at HQ and return; departed cancellation remains rejected and onboard contents stay physical.
Existing Dispatch regression and strict living/UI-map checks pass; examined changed/new purposes reviewed.
authoritative_state: Dispatch manifest remains sole route/handling/intent owner; ledger owns hull, crew, fuel, stock and claims; Yard owns occupied/reserved home slot. Existing cancel_released is once-only intent, cancel_after_route is the existing arrival handoff.
flow: Withdraw future passenger/fleet/cargo commitments once. If Approaching Dispatch, retain that route state and its current plan/deadline; existing timed owner finishes arrival at the real berth, then _finish_route enters Cancelling. Existing cancellation handling unloads real contents and schedules return to held home slot. Otherwise retain current predeparture handling/cancellation flow.
commands_events: accept admits current hull and claims; cancel records withdrawal once. set_route_profile/change_mode/add_field_gun reject after cancel_released even while physical state remains Approaching Dispatch. No new event source or owner.
timed_work: Existing next_boundary, advance_to, _finish_route, settle and _schedule_cancel only. No new polling, scheduler, callbacks, broad snapshot reads or route recomputation on cancel.
cancellation_late_replacement_failure: Repeat cancel rejects using existing once-only flag. Old cancelled manifest cannot affect reused hull. Same-session route completion consumes its own existing cancel_after_route; new session has fresh manifests. Fuel shortage/damage/blocked route retain existing stop/failure owners and contents, never teleport to parking or certify recovery. No attempt to solve unrelated recovery paths.
safeguards: Keep player withdrawal separate from captured physical work; do not erase freight, crew or current route.
No replacement request/route owner; no idle polling.
Explicit fixture inputs are disclosed; physical component timing is not ordinary opening or Army-need acceptance.
Retain primary lead rear.walk_path replacements at integration; this isolated base does not include them.

references.application: Existing synchronous GDScript command guards remain atomic and contain no await; preserve the existing scene-owned simulation callback instead of adding a timer/coroutine.

references: docs/system_overhaul_plan.json dispatchP06 custody/cancellation proposal; source anchors rechecked
docs/overhaul_inventory.json dispatch ownership/static inventory; not test evidence
reproduction_source: Army developer preserved logs/army-loop/rear-cancel-diagnostic.gd and stdout/stderr in trencho_dev_army; independent checker copies only existing Dispatch fixture pattern, no Army Reader feature dependency.
limits: Explicit disconnected manufactured-hull fixture only; no ordinary empty-field manufacturing, genuine Army need, native-input, visible rendering, all-hazard recovery or60FPS acceptance. PR requires lead technical and designated Designer exact-head reviews; no merge.
implementation: Only four existing command functions change: cancel preserves active approach state and sets the pre-existing arrival handoff; cancel_released now rejects repeated cancel and pending mode/route/gun edits. Existing _finish_route, next_boundary, advance_to, unloading and parking code remain unchanged.
